payload.title: Outlier Detection with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates outlier detection using clustering algorithms in the Pyleoclim library. It focuses on two main algorithms: k-means and DBSCAN, applied to paleoclimate data in LiPD format. The notebook explains the parameters and diagnostic metrics of each algorithm, and how to apply them for effective outlier detection.
